descriptions.nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is an open frontier-reasoning and orchestration model from NVIDIA. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 550B total parameters, of which 55B are active, built on a hybrid Transformer-Mamba mixture-of-experts architecture.
descriptions.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA, with 12B active parameters out of 120B total. It takes text, images, documents, GUI screenshots and video as input.
descriptions.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is an open mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA, with 3B active parameters out of 30B total. It is suited for high-throughput agentic workloads and specialized tasks.
descriptions.nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reas: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is a 30B-A3B open multimodal model designed to function as a perception and context sub-agent in enterprise agent systems. It accepts text, image, video and audio input.
descriptions.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety is a compact 4B-parameter multimodal guardrail model from NVIDIA, fine-tuned from Google Gemma-3-4B. It moderates both inputs to and responses from LLMs and VLMs.
descriptions.dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free: Dots3-Note Preview is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model from Dots Studio, with 16B active parameters out of 280B total. It is the lightest model in the Dots 3 family.
descriptions.thinkingmachines/inkling:free: Inkling is an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Thinking Machines Lab, with 41B active parameters out of 975B total. It is designed for general-purpose reasoning, coding, agentic and tool-use systems.
descriptions.thinkingmachines/inkling-small:free: Inkling Small is an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Thinking Machines Lab, with 12B active parameters out of 276B total. It is positioned as the smaller, more efficient Inkling model.
descriptions.cohere/north-mini-code:free: North Mini Code is Cohere's first agentic coding model and the debut of its North family. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 30B total parameters and 3B active.
descriptions.xingchen-agi/xing4.0-29b-a4b:free: Xing4.0-29B-A4B is an open-weight mixture-of-experts language model from China Telecom's AI team (TeleAI) and the successor to the TeleChat series. It has 29B total parameters with 4B active per token.
descriptions.recursive/flint-v1.0:free: Flint is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model from Recursive, with about 2.5B active parameters out of 40B total. It was built by Recursive's autoresearch system, Eureka Machine, for coding agents.
descriptions.liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free: LFM2.5-2.6B is a compact reasoning model from Liquid AI. It is suited for agent workflows, data extraction, RAG and long-context processing. Liquid advises against using it for agentic coding.
descriptions.google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT is an instruction-tuned Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from Google DeepMind. Despite 25.2B total parameters, only 3.8B activate per token during inference, delivering near-31B quality.
